thread:
deploybot: preflight-check failed: sealed-bundle checksum mismatch on staging-4. expected sha256:7b9a...8f3d but got sha256:7b9a...9f3e. halting canary rollout.

leo: hold up 1 why did checksum drift between packaging and mirror? any tar/gzip differences?

olivia: pulling logs from packager. looks like gzip timestamp/owner metadata changed. packager used gzip default which embeds mtime. quick log: 
```
packager: created sealed-bundle.tar.gz (mtime=2026-03-21T10:12:03Z)
mirror-sync: blob uploaded (mtime=2026-03-21T10:12:10Z)
```

sophia: that can change digest across builds even with same file contents. we should be using deterministic gzip flags and stable file ordering for sealed artifacts.

dave: agreed. we do have a rebuild flag `--deterministic-gzip` but it wasn't enabled for this run (pack job env var missing).

nora: customer-facing impact? any installs already started?

leo: canary hasn't started (deploybot halted). no customer installs. low blast radius, but we can't ship mismatched signed artifacts.

olivia: options: 1) repackage with deterministic flags and resign (recommended), 2) force-accept current artifact and proceed (not allowed for Private/VPC), 3) roll back to previous release 1.4.6 and postpone.

sophia: regulatory/compliance says no to option 2. prefer 1. If repack goes green within 45m we keep timeline.

dave: plan: abort current canary, create hotfix/repack branch, run deterministic pack, run cosign and mirror sync, verify checksums on staging-*, then resume canary. I'll own the repack job.

leo: make it explicit in release notes and internal changelog: repack reason and new digests. Also record fallback: if repack fails >3 times or signer errors, revert to 1.4.6 and notify customers.

olivia: creating branch: `git checkout -b release/1.4.7-repack && git push origin release/1.4.7-repack`

dave: kicking packager with flags: `./scripts/rebuild-sealed --manifest=private-vpc-1.4.7 --deterministic-gzip --preserve-order --cosign=false` then we will cosign after checksum verification. starting job pkg-318500 now.

deploybot: packaging aborted for canary (manifest=private-vpc-1.4.7). canary_status=aborted. trig_job(pkg-318500) submitted.

nora: adding note for support to hold any outbound installer links until we confirm new digests.

sophia: setting alert: if pkg-318500 runtime > 40m or checksums still mismatch across staging nodes, escalate to infra and page oncall.

dave: packager finished locally. new digest computed: sealed-bundle sha256:3c5d...a1b7. uploading to mirror and then cosign.

olivia: remember to pin the image digest in the release manifest too. I'll update release notes and the private docs (KMS key/ signer id) once cosign finishes.

deploybot: cosign job started for manifest release/1.4.7-repack, attempt 1/5.

sophia: quick rollback play: if canary fails health checks after resume and error rate >1.2% across nodes, run `revert-release --to=1.4.6 --reason=checksum-drift` and open a postmortem.

leo: agreed. dave, nora, keep comms tight. everyone please ack when repack signed and ready.

dave: 7 packaging succeeded, cosign succeeded, mirror checksums verified across staging-1..4. new pinned digests: installer sha256:5f2b...c8d2, sealed-bundle sha256:3c5d...a1b7.

olivia: pushed updated release notes: "Note: 1.4.7 packaging was repackaged to ensure deterministic artifacts; pinned digests updated. No customer installs were affected. See internal changelog for details."

nora: support notified and airgap docs updated with new checksums.

sophia: resuming canary in 10m. deploybot will verify checksums during rollout.

deploybot: canary-window resumed (manifest=private-vpc-1.4.7-repack) start in 10m. monitoring health and checksum parity.

leo: thanks team. follow-up: add deterministic-gzip to packager defaults and include a CI check to detect mtime variance so this doesn't slip again. will assign in retrospective. everyone thumbs? :thumbsup:
